s1.syndrome_frame: Acute rectal bleeding with recent diarrhea in a postoperative patient
salient_findings: Multiple episodes of bright red blood per rectum
Circumferential wall thickening of the distal rectum with surrounding inflammatory change
Multiple, punched-out, irregular, nonbleeding ulcers in the rectum
key_facts: Recent coronary artery bypass graft surgery
Multiple episodes of bright red blood per rectum
No abdominal pain, rectal pain, melena, fevers, or chills
Circumferential wall thickening of the distal rectum
Multiple, punched-out, irregular, nonbleeding ulcers in the rectum

raw.syndrome_frame: Acute rectal bleeding with recent diarrhea in a postoperative patient
salient_findings: Multiple episodes of bright red blood per rectum

Multiple, punched-out, irregular, nonbleeding ulcers in the rectum
key_facts: Recent coronary artery bypass graft surgery

differentials: Rectal ulceration due to nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs
per_call: Rectal ulceration due to nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs

shortlist.label: Cytomegalovirus colitis
shortlist.why_kept: Viral cytopathic inclusions and CMV immunostain positive

shortlist.label: Ischemic colitis
shortlist.why_kept: Recent coronary artery bypass graft surgery and dual antiplatelet therapy

shortlist.label: Inflammatory bowel disease
shortlist.why_kept: Active colitis with ulcer and crypt distortion

shortlist.label: Radiation proctitis
shortlist.why_kept: Recent surgery and potential radiation exposure

raw.rationale: Viral cytopathic inclusions highlighted by CMV immunostain and active colitis with ulcer are key evidence-based reasons for this diagnosis

rejected.label: Ischemic colitis
rejected.why: No evidence of ischemia, and recent coronary artery bypass graft surgery does not directly relate to colitis

rejected.label: Clostridioides difficile colitis
rejected.why: Diarrhea could be a symptom, but viral cytopathic inclusions and CMV immunostain point away from this diagnosis

rejected.label: Inflammatory bowel disease
rejected.why: Crypt distortion and reactive changes could be seen in IBD, but the presence of viral cytopathic inclusions and CMV immunostain suggests a different etiology

rejected.label: Radiation proctitis
rejected.why: No history of radiation therapy mentioned in the vignette
